title: Social on a schedule you set once
message: Fifteen networks through one connection, on posting slots you set once — with approval enforced on the server
audience: Marketers running a daily social presence for one or several brands

scenes.headline: Social, on a schedule you set *once.*
scenes.narration: A daily social presence, across every network you use, without a daily chore. This is Distribute.

scenes.headline: Fifteen networks, one *connection.*
scenes.narration: Fifteen networks through one connection. LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Snapchat, WhatsApp and Discord. One post fans out to every selected account, and each keeps its own status afterwards. Account health is coloured by the network's own verdict.

callouts.text: Each account keeps its own status.

scenes.headline: Compose once. Send *everywhere.*
scenes.narration: Compose once. Where a network needs its own version, override the text or the image for that network alone. Character counts run against each network's real limit, and image requirements are enforced before you send. Then queue it into the next free slot, schedule it for a time you pick, or post it now.

callouts.label: Per network
callouts.title: Text and image overrides where a network needs its own version

scenes.headline: 09:00 stays 09:00 through *daylight saving.*
scenes.narration: Posting slots are recurring send times, stored as wall clock in your timezone, so nine o'clock stays nine o'clock through daylight-saving changes. Queue drops a post into the next free slot. Set the slots once, and the queue has times to send at.
scenes.spoken: Posting slots are recurring send times, stored as wall clock in your timezone, so nine o'clock stays nine o'clock through daylight-saving changes. Queue drops a post into the next free slot. Set the slots once, and the queue has times to send at.

callouts.label: Stored as
callouts.title: Wall clock, in your timezone
callouts.note: weekday + minute, so DST never shifts a slot

callouts.text: Queue drops a post into the next free slot.

scenes.headline: Drag it. Campaign it. *Recycle it.*
scenes.narration: The calendar shows the month; drag a post to reschedule it. Auto-generated posts come from your Topics, up to a weekly quota you choose, optionally under a named campaign with its own tracking parameters. And evergreen recycling clones a post that performed into free slots after its cooldown. Opt in, and a recycled post is never itself recycled.

callouts.label: Evergreen
callouts.title: A post that performed is cloned into free slots after its cooldown
callouts.note: opt-in; a recycled post is never itself recycled

scenes.headline: Enforced on the server, not just the *screen.*
scenes.narration: Turn on the approval workflow and a pending post cannot be sent, scheduled, queued or dragged. That is enforced on the server, not just in the interface. Queue on approval makes approving the last human act. And Engage keeps comments, direct messages and reviews in one place, with the twenty-four-hour reply window for Facebook and Instagram made visible.

callouts.label: Queue on approval
callouts.title: Approving becomes the last human act

callouts.label: Engage
callouts.title: DM reply window, Facebook and Instagram
